steps.title: Configure project settings and Gradle properties
steps.description: Establish build settings, repository declarations, and global Gradle properties compatible with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Configure app level dependencies and Android environment
steps.description: Configure compile SDK, target SDK, namespace and source compatibility parameters for Java 17 / compile SDK 34.

steps.title: Define application manifest and activities
steps.description: Declare the application configurations, theme styling, icon resources, and MainActivity inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create color resources and application themes
steps.description: Define consistent professional branding using deep blue primary and accent colors within colors.xml and themes.xml.

steps.title: Define string resources for multi-language support
steps.description: Populate strings.xml with localizable names, labels, confirmation prompts, and example queries.

steps.title: Create modular custom background drawables
steps.description: Create shape XML files for styling headers, inputs, buttons, and material cards natively without external UI toolkits.

steps.title: Design multi-screen responsive XML layout
steps.description: Compose dynamic sub-screen containers inside activity_main.xml to host the Dashboard, Database Manager, SQL Editor, Table Data Browsers, and Settings screens.

steps.title: Implement SQL Statement Parser
steps.description: Implement SqlParser.java to reliably split multiple semicolon-separated SQL commands while skipping semicolons in quoted literals, and isolate statement types.

steps.title: Create persistent global history database helper
steps.description: Build SystemDbHelper.java to save and retrieve query history entries, status outcomes, execution times, and target database connections.

steps.title: Implement core database management activity business logic
steps.description: Program MainActivity.java to bind UI components, handle user lifecycle actions, manage local database files, execute operations transactionally, and catch SQLite exceptions safely.

steps.title: Perform app functional integration tests and compile error fixes
steps.description: Verify system functions including fixing any Java compilation errors related to incorrect dimension unit suffixes in code.

steps.title: Building SQL Database Manager
steps.description: Perform clean assembly compilation of the project to generate the final debug APK using standard Gradle toolchains.
